findings.reason: without the census in its done-when, merging §14 silently invalidates the stored review of every plan and buys a one-time local-lane review wave, the exact cost §8's correction exists to prevent.
findings.text: the section redefines the `plan_fingerprint` digest without the safeguard the repository already recorded for a fingerprint-definition change (census the stored plan-review sidecars before merge, and keep a stored fingerprint equal to the legacy digest counting as current), recorded in this plan's own §8 correction after 37 of 51 sidecars flipped and a ~44-review wave launched

findings.reason: the plan must name `reckon/_store.py` as the owner to extend with an exported predicate, so the card recogniser lives once and the declaration is not mistaken for a collapse.
findings.text: §14's stated mechanism ("digests a collapsed section by its identity and declaration alone") either re-spells the `section-landed` convention owned by `reckon/_store.py` (`_is_structural_boundary` at line 820, `_landed_card_span` at line 978, via the private `_class_list`) or, taken literally, keys "collapsed" off the `done` declaration and so stops counting the authored prose of the many sections that are declared `done` but not collapsed (§5–§8 in this plan)

findings.reason: the item's own rule requires the section that adds interface surface to account for it in its text, so §13 must name the entry it retires, or state why the view's existing rows cannot be read directly.
findings.text: §13's text adds a public definition, `velocity.current_week_interface_counts` (one public entry over the view's weekly rows), and does not name anything it retires or merges, nor why nothing can be

interface_budget-1.reason: section 13 is landed; velocity.current_week_interface_counts is the one public entry over the view's private weekly rows (_interface_week_rows), which had no public reader for the composer to call, so it retires nothing and nothing could be read directly; recorded here as the account the item asks for

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §14 changes one function inside `reckon/crew/plan_review.py`, whose store/read/list/fingerprint/response interface already hides the record shape, the durable path and the join.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §14 must recognise a collapsed-section card, a convention owned by `reckon/_store.py` and not exported, so a recogniser in `plan_review.py` would re-spell the owner's markup.
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — public_definitions 1469, cli_options 317, mcp_views 33, refusal_families 23; §13 adds the `current_week_interface_counts` public entry without naming in its text what it retires or merges, or why nothing can be.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §14 changes `plan_fingerprint`'s digest definition but does not carry the sidecar-census safeguard the codebase already recorded for exactly this change; §8's landed correction measured 37 of 51 stored plan-review sidecars flipping and a ~44-review wave when the fingerprint definition last moved.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the plan's review machinery extends the existing review reflex (design brief D6, "extends the existing review reflex rather than copying it") rather than layering a parallel one, and §14 adds no new wrapper.
